daemon.description: Run tcpreen in daemon mode (background process).

bind_address.description: Network interface or IP address to listen on for client connections.

max_bytes.description: Limit session length in bytes. 0 means no limit.

connect_to_client.description: Connect to a specified client instead of waiting for a client to connect.

log_format.description: Output format for captured data (hex, raw, strip, count, null, C, password).

log_file.description: Log file path. Use '-' for stdout.

max_fork.description: Maximum number of simultaneous sessions (forks) allowed.

max_connections.description: Handle this many connections then exit. 0 means run forever.

numeric.description: Disable reverse DNS lookup and service name resolution.

run_as_user.description: Username to drop privileges to after binding socket (requires root initially).

protocol.description: Network protocol(s) to use (tcp, tcp6, unix, local).

quiet.description: Turn on quiet mode: do not write to stdout.

server_hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the server to connect to (if not local).

server_port.description: The server port to monitor or connect to.

local_port.description: Local port to listen on for clients. 0 means dynamically allocated.
